title: SAMPA: Transformer-based segmentation of prosodic boundaries in Brazilian Portuguese
abstract: arXiv:2607.07408v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automatic prosodic segmentation identifies boundaries between speech units based on acoustic and linguistic evidence. Although recent deep learning approaches have achieved strong results for English, automatic segmentation for Brazilian Portuguese (BP) still relies largely on rule-based or traditional machine-learning methods. This paper presents SAMPA, a Whisper-based segmenter that transcribes BP speech while inserting explicit markers for terminal prosodic boundaries. We fine-tune Whisper large-v3 on manually segmented recordings from the NURC-Sampa dataset and evaluate different training and test-time filtering configurations, including out-of-distribution testing on the MuPe-Diversidades dataset. Without test-time filtering, the best models reach f1 binary of 0.730 on the held-out test split and 0.793 on MuPe-Diversidades, outperforming an out-of-the-box Whisper baseline and a retrained feature-based classifier. translated_title: SAMPA：基于Transformer的巴西葡萄牙语韵律边界分割
translated_abstract: 自动韵律分割基于声学和语言学证据来识别语音单元之间的边界。尽管近期的深度学习方法在英语上取得了优异的成果，但巴西葡萄牙语（BP）的自动分割仍然主要依赖基于规则或传统机器学习的方法。本文提出了SAMPA，一个基于Whisper的分割器，它在转录巴西葡萄牙语语音的同时插入明确的终端韵律边界标记。我们在NURC-Sampa数据集的人工分割录音上对Whisper large-v3进行微调，并评估了不同的训练和测试时过滤配置，包括在MuPe-Diversidades数据集上进行的分布外测试。在不使用测试时过滤的情况下，最佳模型在留出测试集上达到0.730的二分类f1值，在MuPe-Diversidades上达到0.793，超越了开箱即用的Whisper基线和重新训练的基于特征的分类器。
tldr: 本文提出SAMPA，通过在人工标注数据上微调Whisper large-v3模型，实现巴西葡萄牙语语音转录的同时自动标注终端韵律边界，性能超越了开箱即用的Whisper基线和基于特征的分类器。
